title: Feather bold character specimen
slide_intent: Demonstrate a typeface beyond the logo because a brand needs a consistent voice for many words and languages.
strategic_value: A broader character set can extend Duolingo’s recognizable letter shapes into everyday communications.
demonstration: A green rounded panel contains white lowercase and uppercase alphabets, accented a forms and numerals beneath the Feather bold title.
practical_value: Check whether the face carries its character across cases, accents and figures.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Center the Feather bold name above the specimen.

content_islands.name: Character repertoire
content_islands.spec: Arrange lowercase, uppercase, accented forms and digits in separate rows on green.

reference_purposes.Expression: The specimen presents the custom face across letters, accents and numerals.
reference_purposes.Intent: The case study says the fine-tuned logotype was extrapolated into further characters to create Feather Bold.

ingredient.name: Feather Bold and the Duolingo wordmark
ingredient.application: Use the specimen to compare character coverage and consistency beyond the brand name.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2019 case-study evidence. These are observed design relationships, not a license to redraw the mark or a complete type-usage specification.
